name: tracklution
description: Install and verify Tracklution server-side conversion tracking, and answer questions about your tracking data, through the Tracklution MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Tracklution is server-side conversion tracking for websites. Connect your Tracklution account to ask about your tracking data in plain language: conversions, revenue, events, sessions and data quality (consent, ad blockers and delivery to ad platforms) for every tracking container your account can access. Tracklution can also guide a new installation: it checks your website, creates your account and first container, returns the tracking snippets for your platform and verifies that events arrive. Analytics tools only read data; installation steps create an account or change container settings. Analytics requires a Tracklution account; sign-in uses OAuth.
defaultPrompt: How many conversions did my website track last week compared to the week before?
Is my tracking healthy? Check data quality, consent and ad blockers.
Help me install Tracklution tracking on my website.

positive.prompt: How many conversions did my Tracklution containers track last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's containers and reports last week's conversion counts per container from the summary, without inventing numbers.

positive.prompt: Show daily purchases and revenue for my main website over the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a day-by-day series of purchases and revenue for the chosen container and date range.

positive.prompt: Is my tracking data healthy? Check consent, ad blockers and delivery.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the insights findings for the container: consent, ad-blocker recovery and delivery issues.

positive.prompt: List the 10 most recent Purchase events with their order values.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 recent Purchase events with timestamps and values.

positive.prompt: Show the settings of my main tracking container.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the chosen container's name, website and tracking configuration without exposing secrets.

negative.prompt: Delete all tracking data from my container.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Tracklution cannot delete data from chat and points to the dashboard; calls no write tool.

negative.prompt: Show me the conversion numbers of competitor.com.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it can only read containers the connected account can access; does not guess or fabricate data.

negative.description: Ad budget changes are out of scope
negative.prompt: Raise my Google Ads budget by 20%.
negative.expected_behavior: Declines: Tracklution reports tracking data and does not manage ad platform budgets.

review.commerce_description: Tracklution does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: analytics questions and guided installation through the Tracklution MCP server.
